evaluation_domains.description: How well was the recovery program governed?
questions: Were clear governance structures established for the recovery program?
Were roles and responsibilities clearly defined and understood?
Were decisions made in a timely and transparent manner?
Was there appropriate escalation and resolution of issues?
Were resources allocated effectively and accounted for?

evaluation_domains.description: How effectively were communities engaged in recovery?
questions: Were affected communities consulted in recovery planning?
Were community needs and priorities reflected in recovery activities?
Were vulnerable groups specifically engaged and supported?
Was information provided in accessible formats and languages?
Were community feedback mechanisms established and responsive?

evaluation_domains.description: Did the recovery program achieve its intended outcomes?
questions: To what extent were recovery outcomes achieved?
Were sustainability objectives met (community managing own recovery)?
Were resilience objectives met (community better prepared)?
Were there unintended positive or negative outcomes?
How did outcomes vary across different domains and populations?
Were recovery activities delivered in a cost-effective manner?
Were timelines and milestones met?
Were there delays and what caused them?
Could the same outcomes have been achieved with fewer resources?
Were there economies of scale or synergies across programs?

evaluation_domains.description: How well was the recovery program implemented?
questions: Were recovery activities implemented as planned?
Were there adaptations required during implementation?
Were monitoring data used to inform implementation decisions?
Were partnerships and coordination effective?
Were lessons captured and applied during implementation?
